title: Ayyooo!
delivery: A long wail of shock that starts high and falls slowly.

title: Shivaneee!
delivery: A desperate prayer. Rise on 'shi', then hold the final 'eee'.

title: Manasilaayo?
delivery: Slow and menacing. Lean on every syllable.

title: Kunjimone…
delivery: Sweet and sing-song, like calling a child for lunch.

title: Chettaaa!
delivery: Shouted across a busy road. One long call.

title: Entammo!
delivery: Total disbelief. A quick rise, then a drawn-out 'mmo'.

title: Shari… shari… SHARI.
delivery: Polite at first, angrier each time. Three beats.

title: Enthuvaade ithu?
delivery: Puzzled and annoyed. Rise on the question.

title: Ninakku njan kaanichu tharaam!
delivery: A tiny villain's threat. Low, slow, then a short evil laugh.

title: Sathyam!
delivery: Dramatic courtroom oath. One loud, firm word.

title: Kashtam…
delivery: Deeply disappointed. Add a tut before the word.

title: Adipoli!
delivery: Pure hype. Bounce on 'a-di', explode on 'poli'.

title: Ente ponno!
delivery: Exhausted and exasperated. Sigh into it.

title: Ente chaaya evide?
delivery: Asked as if this is the greatest betrayal of your life.

title: Njan ippo ethum!
delivery: Completely unjustified confidence. You are still in bed.

title: Ithokke aaraa kazhichathu?
delivery: Staring at the bill in dramatic disbelief.

title: Enikku oru idea undu!
delivery: Announced like a very small villain with a very bad plan.
